question: What per-agent archive, restore, and clone contract should OpenClaw core own, especially for OAuth profiles, SecretRefs, session transcripts, workspace files, and destructive restore/rollback behavior?
rationale: The requested feature crosses sensitive persisted state, private transcripts, config mutation, and overlapping backup/migration efforts, so automation cannot safely choose the product and security boundary.

options.title: Define Minimal Core Per-Agent Restore
options.body: Sponsor a preview-first `--agent`/`--as` design with explicit credential/session policy, path containment, conflict handling, rollback, tests, and docs before implementation.

options.title: Defer Until Broader Backup Design
options.body: Keep this open but block implementation until the broader native backup/restore and migration contracts settle a shared archive format and restore safety model.

options.title: Route Most Cloning To ClawHub
options.body: Keep core limited to missing APIs and document that optional agent clone workflows should live in plugins or ClawHub unless a core state API is missing.

recommendation.title: Define Minimal Core Per-Agent Restore
recommendation.body: Sponsor a preview-first `--agent`/`--as` design with explicit credential/session policy, path containment, conflict handling, rollback, tests, and docs before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision needs product/security routing across core backup, session state, credentials, and plugin/ClawHub boundaries, and steipete is the strongest recent routing candidate from history and related review context.
